name: NeedyMeds
description: NeedyMeds is a nonprofit providing a comprehensive database of patient assistance programs, helping people find affordable medications and healthcare services regardless of insurance status.
fullDescription: NeedyMeds is a nonprofit providing a comprehensive database of patient assistance programs, helping people find affordable medications and healthcare services regardless of insurance status.
whatTheyOffer:
- Searchable database of patient assistance programs
- Free drug discount card
- Drug price and pharmacy lookup
- Listings of free/low-cost clinics
- Coupons and rebates for medications
howToGetIt: Visit needymeds.org and search programs by drug name, or search for clinics and coupons. Request the free NeedyMeds Drug Discount Card online.
keywords: NeedyMeds, patient assistance, prescription discount, drug discount card, free medication, affordable medicine, low-cost clinic
